annotations.title: Draft a new public AI agent

description: Prepare a new public AI agent from a name and a description of who or what it represents and what it should do — a person, brand, product, business, character, coach or specialist. Checks that its address (handle.agenturo.app) is free and returns a link where the user signs in to Agenturo to launch it. Nothing is created or reserved until they do.

description.description: Who or what the agent represents, who it talks to, what it should help them with, and how it should sound.

handle.description: Preferred address, 5–15 lowercase letters or digits (becomes handle.agenturo.app). Derived from the name when omitted.

name.description: The agent's display name, usually the person, brand or product it represents.
